stratified_examples.question: How can I upload my own image to the Wix Logo Maker and customize it?
stratified_examples.candidate_answer:
To upload and customize your own image in the Wix Logo Maker:

- Upload your image via the Upload icon on the left side of the logo editor.
- Select "Upload Image" and choose an image from your computer or connected social networks like Facebook, Instagram, or Google Drive.
- Once uploaded, you can customize the image's size, position, and shadows directly within the Logo Maker.
- For advanced editing, use the Wix Photo Studio without leaving the Logo Maker.
- You can also remove the background of your uploaded image using the "Remove Background" tool in the image customization settings by clicking on the image after upload.

These steps ensure your logo is unique and tailored to your needs [S1][S2].

stratified_examples.question: How can I restore an archived program in Wix Online Programs?
stratified_examples.candidate_answer:
You cannot directly restore an archived program in Wix Online Programs. However, you can duplicate the archived program and publish the new draft. The steps are:

- Go to Online Programs in your site's dashboard.
- Click the Archived tab.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant archived program.
- Select Duplicate.
- The duplicated program will appear in the Drafts tab.
- From the Drafts tab, click the More Actions icon next to the duplicate program and publish or edit as needed [S1].

stratified_examples.question: How can I change the main color in my site's color palette using ADI?
stratified_examples.candidate_answer:
To change the main color in your site's color palette using ADI:

- Select **Colors**.

stratified_examples.question: How can I add and set up a range slider in my CMS to filter content by a number value?
stratified_examples.candidate_answer:
To add and set up a range slider in your CMS to filter content by a number value, follow these steps:

- Navigate to the page or section where you want to add the filter.
- Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor.
- Select **Input**, then **Slider**.
- Scroll to **Range Sliders** and drag the desired range slider onto the page.
- Click the **Connect to CMS** icon on the range slider.
- In the **Connect Range Slider** panel, select **Filter content**.
- Choose the dataset connected to the elements you want to filter (e.g., repeater, gallery, table).
- Select the number field visitors will use to filter content from the **Filter content by** drop-down.
- Set the filter condition using the **Condition** drop-down (e.g., "Between" to show items within the slider range).
- Optionally, add a new field to your collection for filtering by selecting **Add new field**, entering the field name, and clicking **Add**.

This setup allows visitors to filter content dynamically based on the number range they select with the slider [S1][S2].
stratified_examples.gt_answer:
To add and set up a range slider in your CMS to filter content by a number value, follow these steps:

1. **Go to your editor**: [Access your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).

2. **Add the range slider input element**:
   
   1. Go to the page or section where you want visitors to filter content by a number value.

   1. Click the **Connect to CMS** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2023/06/16/2d484f5d-e1bf-4d48-9e42-82216e8b88de/08e74518-edad-42f8-b007-c974ba767eb6.png) on the range slider.

   4. Click the **Filter content by** drop-down and choose the number field that visitors will use to filter the content.

     + **Slider type:** Choose a continuous or stepped slider type:
       
       - **Continuous:** Visitors can select any value within the set range.
       - **Stepped:** Visitors can select specific, incremental values within the set range. Set up the following options:
         
         * **Set steps by:** Click the drop-down and choose how you want to set the steps:
           
           + **Number of steps:** You choose how many steps appear in the range slider. Enter the number of steps in the **Steps** field.
           + **Step value:** You choose the value increments of each step, up to 100. Enter the value of the increments in the **Value** field.

   * Click the **Layout** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2024/04/24/1e3a7616-1ca3-40ad-9e94-d2e18bfd4b98/33c4ffdc-7138-462f-b6e2-4d6505f6f8f6.png) to adjust the following:
     
     + The size and shape of your range slider handles.
     + The track height (thickness) of the track that the handles slide on.
     + Choose a **Left to right** or **Right to left** range display direction.
     + Adjust the alignment, offset, and spacing around the field title.

5. **Click Preview** to test your range slider.

stratified_examples.question: How can I upload my own image to the Wix Logo Maker and customize it?
stratified_examples.candidate_answer:
To upload and customize your own image in the Wix Logo Maker:

- Upload your image via the Upload icon on the left side of the logo editor.
- Select "Upload Image" and choose an image from your computer or connected social networks like Facebook, Instagram, or Google Drive.
- Once uploaded, you can customize the image's size, position, and shadows directly within the Logo Maker.
- For advanced editing, use the Wix Photo Studio without leaving the Logo Maker.
- You can also remove the background of your uploaded image using the "Remove Background" tool in the image customization settings by clicking on the image after upload.

   1. **Upload an image:**

      4. Click **Upload Selection**.

   2. **Use a site file:**
      1. Select the image you want to add to your logo.

   * **Image opacity:** Drag the slider to increase or decrease the transparency of your image.
   * **Flip:** Flip your image horizontally or vertically.
   * **Rotate:** Drag the slider to rotate your image.
   * **Horizontal position:** Drag the slider to move your image left or right.
   * **Vertical position:** Drag the slider to move your image up or down.
   * **Shadow:** Click the toggle to enable a shadow around your image and customize the following:

stratified_examples.question: How can I restore an archived program in Wix Online Programs?
stratified_examples.candidate_answer:
You cannot directly restore an archived program in Wix Online Programs. However, you can duplicate the archived program and publish the new draft. The steps are:

- Go to Online Programs in your site's dashboard.
- Click the Archived tab.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant archived program.
- Select Duplicate.
- The duplicated program will appear in the Drafts tab.
- From the Drafts tab, click the More Actions icon next to the duplicate program and publish or edit as needed [S1].

stratified_examples.question: Can I get a refund for a logo purchased from Wix Logo Maker if I cancel my Logo + Website plan within 14 days?
stratified_examples.candidate_answer:
- Logos purchased from Wix Logo Maker are non-refundable as they are digital goods and usage cannot be monitored after download.
- If you cancel your Logo + Website plan within 14 days, you are only entitled to a refund for the website subscription, not for the logo files.
- Any discount applied to the logo files in the plan will be revoked and deducted from the subscription refund.
- In some cases where the logo files price exceeds the plan price, no refund will be given.
- After cancellation, you may still retain benefits of the Advanced Logo Maker plan, depending on the plan type (e.g., Unlimited, Business, or Social) [S1].

stratified_examples.question: How can I review reports about members from my site's dashboard?
stratified_examples.candidate_answer:
To review reports about members from your site's dashboard:

- Go to **Site Members** in your site's dashboard.
- Click the **Reported** tab to see members who have been reported.
- Click the **More Actions** icon next to the relevant member.
- Choose **Review Reports** to see details such as the reporting member, date, and reason if provided.

This process allows you to manage member reports efficiently from your dashboard [S1][S2].
stratified_examples.gt_answer:
To review reports from your site's dashboard:

1. [Go to Site Members](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Members%20List&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/member-permissions/members) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **Reported** tab.
3. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant member.
4. Choose what to do with this member:
   
   * **Review Reports:** See the report details, including the member who submitted the report, the date and the reason, if the member specified it.
     
     + According to how you want to handle this report, click **Block Member** or **Remove Reports**.
   * **Remove Reports:** Delete and dismiss the report that was submitted about this member.
   * **View member:** Before making your decision, open the reported member's Contact Card to see more details about them.
   * **Block member:** Block this member from your Members Area, so they can't access it nor sign up again using the same email address.

### Note
When removing a report, it gets automatically deleted with no option to see it again in the future.

stratified_examples.question: How can I add and set up a range slider in my CMS to filter content by a number value?
stratified_examples.candidate_answer:
To add and set up a range slider in your CMS to filter content by a number value, follow these steps:

- Navigate to the page or section where you want to add the filter.
- Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor.
- Select **Input**, then **Slider**.
- Scroll to **Range Sliders** and drag the desired range slider onto the page.
- Click the **Connect to CMS** icon on the range slider.
- In the **Connect Range Slider** panel, select **Filter content**.
- Choose the dataset connected to the elements you want to filter (e.g., repeater, gallery, table).
- Select the number field visitors will use to filter content from the **Filter content by** drop-down.
- Set the filter condition using the **Condition** drop-down (e.g., "Between" to show items within the slider range).
- Optionally, add a new field to your collection for filtering by selecting **Add new field**, entering the field name, and clicking **Add**.

This setup allows visitors to filter content dynamically based on the number range they select with the slider [S1][S2].
stratified_examples.gt_answer:
To add and set up a range slider in your CMS to filter content by a number value, follow these steps:

1. **Go to your editor**: [Access your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).

2. **Add the range slider input element**:
   
   1. Go to the page or section where you want visitors to filter content by a number value.
   2. Click **Add Elements** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/65d5031a-8d20-483c-b08f-0a758e1cf2fd/68a0236f-77f4-43c6-931f-8298ae691a9e/2022/11/17/01f24c8b-2ea3-4d06-a26d-9975a43d617e/a79e245b-4870-4444-ba82-248eca4eb9a7.png) on the left side of the editor.
   3. Click **Input**.
   4. Click **Slider**.
   5. Scroll down to **Range Sliders**, then click and drag the relevant range slider onto the page.

3. **Connect the range slider to the CMS**:
   
   1. Click the **Connect to CMS** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2023/06/16/2d484f5d-e1bf-4d48-9e42-82216e8b88de/08e74518-edad-42f8-b007-c974ba767eb6.png) on the range slider.
   2. Select **Filter content** in the **Connect Range Slider** panel on the right.
   3. Click the **Choose a dataset** drop-down and select the same dataset that connects to the elements (e.g., repeater, gallery, table) that you want visitors to filter.
   4. Click the **Filter content by** drop-down and choose the number field that visitors will use to filter the content.

   **Tip:** To add a new field to your collection and use it for filtering content, select **Add new field**, then enter the field name and click **Add**. You can add content to the field in your CMS collection later.
   5. Click the **Condition** drop-down and select the relevant condition:
      
      * **Between:** Show items that have a connected number field value that is between the range slider handles.
      * **Outside of:** Show items that have a connected number field value that is outside of the range slider handles.

4. **Customize the range slider element**:
   
   * Click **Settings** to customize the following:
     
     + **Field title:** Edit the name that displays on the range slider and lets visitors know what it does.
     + **Slider type:** Choose a continuous or stepped slider type:
       
       - **Continuous:** Visitors can select any value within the set range.
       - **Stepped:** Visitors can select specific, incremental values within the set range. Set up the following options:
         
         * **Set steps by:** Click the drop-down and choose how you want to set the steps:
           
           + **Number of steps:** You choose how many steps appear in the range slider. Enter the number of steps in the **Steps** field.
           + **Step value:** You choose the value increments of each step, up to 100. Enter the value of the increments in the **Value** field.
         * **Value labels:** (Optional) Enter a prefix in the **Prefix** field to have it appear before the value (e.g., $). You can also enter a suffix in the **Suffix** field to have it appear after the value.
   * Click the **Layout** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2024/04/24/1e3a7616-1ca3-40ad-9e94-d2e18bfd4b98/33c4ffdc-7138-462f-b6e2-4d6505f6f8f6.png) to adjust the following:
     
     + The size and shape of your range slider handles.
     + The track height (thickness) of the track that the handles slide on.
     + Choose a **Left to right** or **Right to left** range display direction.
     + Adjust the alignment, offset, and spacing around the field title.
     + (Steps only) Choose a layout: **Lines** or **Dots**.
   * Click the **Design** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2024/04/24/d44e4657-75f7-476b-a92f-c0ed3bc775bc/4d1470bd-bd1d-4d8b-ac9d-5015333e2742.png) to choose a preset design and customize it further.

5. **Click Preview** to test your range slider.
6. **Click Publish** if you are ready to make the changes go live.

**Important:** The range slider is not available in Editor X or the Studio Editor.
